positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintaining and automating experiments for data gathering and metrics. 
Reporting vital data to several dependent teams. 
Establishing a stable testing lab environment, organizing and inventorying test devices.

positions.title: Quality Control Specialist
positions.description:
* Move the needle on CSAT as a result of improvements with processes and people
* Partner with Leads to incorporate quality improvement topics into training, team meetings, round tables, etc.
* Respond to CSAT trends identified by Service Desk Leads to meet CSAT SLAs
* Respond to efficiency/effectiveness trends identified by Service Desk Leads
* Identify changes as needed in processes, standards, and documentation procedures.
* Create, revise documentation as needed
* Provide data for the weekly Service Desk Metrics report
* Develop trends and summary assessments
* Maintain comprehensive records and update all records in a timely manner.
* Review quality efforts with Operations Managers
* Respond quickly to rapidly changing QC needs and scope, at Uber scale.

positions.title: Senior Lab Technician
positions.description:
Data entry for device metadata into BitFit inventory management software
Device management and organization throughout the Netflix campus as well as multiple off-site storage rooms and buildings
Build and maintain custom A/V carts to meet requested specifications from multiple engineering teams
Build and maintain custom network solutions requested from multiple engineering teams
Build and maintain multiple lab environments for multiple engineering teams within the Netflix campus
Build, image, and deploy router systems for partners
Procure, deploy, and maintain CE device hardware
Procure and deploy console development kit activation files for Playstation
Assist Lab Engineering in CE device pool triage, maintenance, and expansion
Assist the multiple internal teams in executing PR events within our labs

positions.title: Device Inventory Coordinator @ Netflix
positions.description:
Maintains accurate inventory for Engineering and Certification teams.
Familiar with various VPN services to provide client end experiences around the world.
Setup and maintain devices to a Keyboard, Video, Mouse switch to remotely access and monitor automated tests. 
Familiar with troubleshooting various game consoles (Xbox 360, Xbox One, PS3, PS4, etc...)
Experience with JIRA and Service Now ticketing systems.

positions.title: AV/VC Operations Technician @ General Electric
positions.description:
Audio/Visual and video teleconference support for GE Software Center. 
Conference room troubleshooting that includes large monitors, projectors, PTZ cameras, Crestron Control panels and transmitters, Extron USB Extenders, and Polycom phones.
White glove event support for low to high priority meetings including AV setup, cable management and complete testing of equipment prior to the start of the meeting to ensure smooth and excellent meetings.
Familiar with Cisco TelePresence Systems while supporting Cisco WebEx, Microsoft Outlook, and other various tools

positions.title: Site Lead for EMT San Francisco @ Google
positions.description:
Trained and lead a team of 7 to efficiently support approximately 1500 users. 
Educated users on how to improve their video conferencing experience. 
Installed video conferencing units in various conference rooms. 
Installed HDMI, VGA, DVI, and Serial cables and adapters in conference rooms.
Maintained desktops and Crestron units in conference rooms. 
Ensured audio visual equipment is functioning for high profile events. 
Maintained user interface labs. 
Installed and replaced video capture cards. 
Troubleshot and resolved User generated tickets with issues in conference rooms.
Reimaged and installed video conferencing equipment.
Inspected and maintained conference rooms daily to ensure functionality and cleanliness for users. 
Trained new hires on aspects of EMT roles such as ticketing, daily inspections, and troubleshooting. 
Reworked aspects of the training guide for new hires. 
Maintained inventory of over 1000+ assets and accessories accurately. 
Maintained Google's ticketing que for EMTs in a timely manner.
Familiar with service-now ticketing system. 
Programming Avaya phones with correct extensions. 
Maintained excellent communication with other teams within Google's network.

positions.title: Equipment Maintenance Technician
positions.description:
Daily inspections of large conference rooms to ensure functionality for events.
Installed workspace setups for new/transferring users.
Maintained inventory of conference room assets.
Responded to and resolved user generated tickets.
Maintained conference rooms for daily use.
Familiar with service-now and other ticketing systems.
Prioritized site wide projects alongside daily responsibilities.

positions.title: Server/Bartender
positions.description:
Maintained excellent customer service
Kept inventory of all alcohol
Maintained a clean workstation
Food handler certified
Kept an accurate and balanced account of transactions for each shift
Knowledgable about restaurant food and drinks
Able to handle multiple orders accurately
Great communication between kitchen staff

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description:
Maintained a neat and organized store
Stocked and faced shelves throughout the store
Maintained careful watch of expiration dates on products.
Maintained and kept an organized backstock inventory of various sections of the store
Accurate and balanced till of daily register shifts
Excellent customer service
Knowledgable about store products
Unloaded evening pallets of product daily
Trained new hires on aspects of crew member roles
